A '''flier''' or '''flyer''' was a term for [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]]-powered [[droid/Legends|droids]] or vehicles. 

==History and definitions==
{{Quote|Grab a flyer, Bane! Let us kill some Jedi!|[[Githany]]|<ref name="JvS">''[[Star Wars: Jedi vs. Sith]]''</ref>}}
During the [[New Sith Wars]], the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] made use of flier vehicles.<ref name="JvS" />

Fliers were common on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

Vehicles such as [[speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] were also called flyers.<ref name="Han Solo at Stars' End">''[[Han Solo at Stars' End]]''</ref> Unlike the earlier Sith fliers,<ref name="JvS" /> those typically had a maximum altitude of 10 [[Imperial_standard_meter|meters]] (32 feet).

The [[boomerang/Legends|boomerang]] droid [[Fido]] was called a miniature flyer.<ref name="Dark Forces: Jedi Knight">''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The comic series ''[[Star Wars: Jedi vs. Sith]]'' initially denoted these vehicles as "flyers", however the novel, ''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]'' and later sources identify these vehicles as "fliers".
